-- Cell H3

WITH DepOutBal AS (
SELECT AccountSK, AccountID, SUM(BalanceAmountFull)/27 AS MTDADB FROM dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance 
    WHERE BusinessDateSK >= 20230101 AND BusinessDateSK <= 20230127
    AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM dw.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_TEST_20231010 WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127)
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY AccountSK, AccountID
)
SELECT SUM(MTDADB) FROM DepOutBal

-- Cell H4

/* 
--Drop staging tables before running the script. If error, table has already been dropped.
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_Balance
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp
DROP TABLE dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance
*/

WITH CasaTdAggregateBalance AS(
    SELECT  * FROM [BNKM].[CasaTdAggregateBalance] WHERE AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
    
	),
	
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId),
	
Balance AS (
SELECT 
	BCB.PeriodEndDate AS BusinessDateSK
	,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
	,BCB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
    ,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCA.FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCB.AccumulatedCurrentBalance AS BalanceAmount
    ,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
FROM CasaTdAggregateBalance BCB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCB.CustomerAccountid = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialproductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON convert(varchar,BCA.BranchId) = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON convert(varchar,BCB.FinancialInstitutionId) = convert(varchar,DDBK.BankID)
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DIMACCOUNT] DDA ON convert(varchar,BCB.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,DDA.AccountID)
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA','SBA','TDA'))
---SELECT COUNT(*) from BALANCE
select * into dw.factdepytdbal_Balance from Balance;
---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dw.factdepytdbal_Balance --- 2,514,897
-------


with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.factdepytdbal_Balance
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) --AND BusinessDateSK >= '2023-01-01'
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,BalanceAmount ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM  dw.factdepytdbal_Balance b
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    --AND 
    BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON --a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    --AND 
    a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance from join_balance;

------

select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp from dw.factdepytdbal_join_balance;



------

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from dw.factdepytdbal_rowgrp BCPB) 

select * into dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance from final_balance;

---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance --- 2,514,777

------

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)

---INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_TEST_20231004  
---(
---BusinessDateSK
---,BranchSK
---,BankSK
---,AccountSK
---,AccountID
---,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
---,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
---,SourceSystemCode
---,WorkFlowId
---,TaskRunId
---,InsertDttm)
, test AS (
select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) as BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE BalanceAmount/DDD.DayOfYear END AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN ((BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ CNT) / DDD.DayOfYear
    ELSE (BalanceAmount / CNT ) / DDD.DayOfYear
    END AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm     
from  dw.factdepytdbal_final_balance   BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMDATE DDD ON  CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) = DDD.DateSK
)
SELECT SUM(AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) FROM test WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127


-- Cell H5

WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND  CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112)  <= 20230127 AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112)  >= 20230127
)

--20230127

, CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,
Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT BCB.CustomerAccountId, COUNT(1) CNT FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCB
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountID 
    and DCA.ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY BCB.CustomerAccountId

)

SELECT 
SUM(CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BCPB.BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END ) AS BalanceAmountFull

FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCPB.PeriodStartDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


-- Cell G4

WITH busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AS AggregateBalanceType
,BDT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS PreviousCurrentBalance
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PreviousClearBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS AccumulatedClearBalance
,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM  BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1'
)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance)
    FROM busc 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)
    AND PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27'


-- Cell G5

WITH busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId,
BDT.TRAN_DATE_BAL
FROM  BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1' AND EOD_DATE <= '2023-01-27' AND END_EOD_DATE >= '2023-01-27'
)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL)
    FROM busc 
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)

-- Cell K4

WITH bnkm AS (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance 
    WHERE PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27' AND AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance)
    FROM bnkm
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)

-- Cell K5

WITH bnkm AS (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, 2023-01-27 PeriodDate , BalanceAmount FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND PeriodStartDate <= '2023-01-27' AND PeriodEndDate >= '2023-01-27' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    AND CustomerAccountId IN (
        SELECT FORACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1
    )

)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(BalanceAmount)
    FROM bnkm
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)



-- Cell L3

SELECT BusinessDateSK, SUM(AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull) AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull  FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127 AND AccountID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BusinessDateSK

-- Cell L4

SELECT BusinessDateSK, SUM(AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull 
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127 
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK

-- Cell L5

SELECT BusinessDateSK, SUM(BalanceAmountFull) BalanceAmountFull 
FROM [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance]
WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127 
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK

/* LNS Billed Amount */

-- # 01
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- # 02
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 
WHERE CustomerAccountId IS NULL OR FinancialInstitutionId IS NULL OR LoanDemandTimestamp IS NULL

-- # 03
select 'Source' Tables, count(1) CNT from BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST WHERE ISLATEST = 1
UNION ALL
select 'Target' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129

-- # 04
WITH 
Source AS ( 
SELECT GAM.FORACID, LAC.BANK_ID, LAC.PRIN_DMD_OS AS SourceColumn 
FROM BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST LAC 
INNER JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST GAM ON LAC.ACID = GAM.ACID 
WHERE LAC.IsLatest = 1 AND GAM.IsLatest = 1), 

Target AS ( 
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PrincipalDemandOutstanding AS TargetColumn 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129) 

SELECT S.FORACID AS SourceID, T.CustomerAccountId AS TargetID, S.SourceColumn, T.TargetColumn 
FROM Source AS S 
JOIN Target AS T ON S.FORACID = T.CustomerAccountId AND S.BANK_ID = T.FinancialInstitutionId 
WHERE S.SourceColumn <> T.TargetColumn

-- # 05
SELECT BusinessDateSK, BankSK, AccountID, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount 
FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
GROUP BY BusinessDateSK, BankSK, AccountID 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- # 06
SELECT BusinessDateSK, BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountID, SourceSystemCode 
FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
WHERE BusinessDateSK IS NULL OR BranchSK IS NULL OR BankSK IS NULL OR AccountSK IS NULL OR AccountID IS NULL OR SourceSystemCode IS NULL 

-- # 07
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 BCA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
AND CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CALD.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM199_20231129 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM199_20231129 DDBK ON CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM199_20231129 DDA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM199_20231129 BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CONVERT(DATE, CALD.LoanDemandTimestamp, 112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp 
WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, COUNT(*) CNT FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129

-- # 08
SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountFull_Original) SUM 
FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(PrincipalDemandOutstanding) SUM 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129

-- # 09
WITH 
CNT_DCA AS (
    SELECT AccountID, COUNT(ShareIndicator) as CNT 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 WHERE ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY AccountID), 

Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
    SELECT CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding / DCA.CNT AS BilledAmountProrated_Original 
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
    LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = CALD.CustomerAccountId) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated_Original) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated_Original) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount


-- # 10
WITH 
Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP'  THEN CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding * BCC.ConversionRate 
    ELSE CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding 
    END AS BilledAmountFull 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 BCA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
    AND CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId 
    AND CALD.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM199_20231129 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID    
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM199_20231129 DDBK ON CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM199_20231129 DDA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM199_20231129 BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
    AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId 
    AND CONVERT(DATE, CALD.LoanDemandTimestamp, 112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp  
WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountFull) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountFull) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount

-- # 11
WITH 
CNT_DCA AS (
    SELECT AccountID, COUNT(ShareIndicator) as CNT 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 WHERE ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
    GROUP BY AccountID), 

Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP' THEN (CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding * BCC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT 
            ELSE CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding / DCA.CNT 
        END AS BilledAmountProrated 
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 BCA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
        AND CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId 
        AND CALD.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode 
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM199_20231129 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID  
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM199_20231129 DDBK ON CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM199_20231129 DDA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
    LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM199_20231129 BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
        AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId 
        AND CONVERT(DATE, CALD.LoanDemandTimestamp, 112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp 
    LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = CALD.CustomerAccountId 
    WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount




/* LNS Billed Amount v.2 */

-- # 1

SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- # 2

SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, LoanDemandTimestamp 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 
WHERE CustomerAccountId IS NULL OR FinancialInstitutionId IS NULL OR LoanDemandTimestamp IS NULL

-- # 3

SELECT 'Source' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST_BU_20231204 WHERE ISLATEST = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Target' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129

-- # 4

WITH Source AS ( 
SELECT GAM.FORACID, LAC.BANK_ID, LAC.PRIN_DMD_OS AS SourceColumn 
FROM BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST_BU_20231204 LAC 
INNER JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST_BU_20231204 GAM ON LAC.ACID = GAM.ACID 
WHERE LAC.IsLatest = 1 AND GAM.IsLatest = 1), 
Target AS ( 
SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, PrincipalDemandOutstanding AS TargetColumn 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129) 
SELECT S.FORACID AS SourceID, T.CustomerAccountId AS TargetID, S.SourceColumn, T.TargetColumn 
FROM Source AS S

-- # 9

WITH 
CNT_DCA AS (SELECT AccountID, COUNT(ShareIndicator) as CNT 
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 WHERE ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
GROUP BY AccountID), 

Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
SELECT CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding / DCA.CNT AS BilledAmountProrated_Original 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = CALD.CustomerAccountId) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated_Original) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated_Original) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount

-- # 10

WITH 
Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
SELECT CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP'  
THEN CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding * BCC.ConversionRate 
ELSE CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding 
END AS BilledAmountFull 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 BCA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
AND CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CALD.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM199_20231129 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM199_20231129 DDBK ON CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM199_20231129 DDA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM199_20231129 BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CONVERT(DATE, CALD.LoanDemandTimestamp, 112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp 
WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountFull) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountFull) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount

-- # 11

WITH 
CNT_DCA AS (SELECT AccountID, COUNT(ShareIndicator) as CNT 
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 WHERE ShareIndicator = 'Y' 
GROUP BY AccountID), 

Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount AS ( 
SELECT CASE WHEN BCA.IsoCurrencyCode != 'PHP' 
THEN (CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding * BCC.ConversionRate) / DCA.CNT 
ELSE CALD.PrincipalDemandOutstanding / DCA.CNT 
END AS BilledAmountProrated 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanDemand_CM199_20231129 CALD 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM199_20231129 BCA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
AND CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = BCA.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CALD.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM199_20231129 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM199_20231129 DDBK ON CALD.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM199_20231129 DDA ON CALD.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM199_20231129 BCC ON BCA.IsoCurrencyCode = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId 
AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND CONVERT(DATE, CALD.LoanDemandTimestamp, 112) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp 
LEFT JOIN CNT_DCA DCA ON DCA.AccountId = CALD.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE DDB.BranchSK IS NOT NULL AND DDBK.BankSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountSK IS NOT NULL AND DDA.AccountID IS NOT NULL) 

SELECT 'Target' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated) SUM FROM DW.FactLoansBilledAmount_CM199_20231129 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Source' AS Tables, SUM(BilledAmountProrated) SUM FROM Temp_FactLoansBilledAmount
